name: chattopod
description: Create a personal Japanese podcast from your conversation and listen in ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: この資料をもとに、自分の仕事に関係する話をポッドキャストにして
この本の原文を、そのまま読み上げて
このニュースを、前提から説明する番組にして
interface.longDescription:
For users aged 18 and over.

Ask ChatToPod to turn the material in your conversation into a Japanese podcast. Use work documents to understand your own tasks, listen to a text you are permitted to use, catch up on research during your commute, or get an explanation based on your lecture notes.

The conversation prepares the script and chapters for your request. ChatToPod generates a natural, single-speaker recording and shows the script and player in the conversation. You can read chapter text, listen to completed chapters while later chapters are being generated, change playback speed, and download an MP3 for a chapter or the complete program.

Choose a male or female voice, reopen a program you made earlier, stop unstarted generation, or ask to remake a completed chapter. Only your own programs are accessible. This plugin generates Japanese audio; it does not clone voices, create multi-speaker recordings, edit uploaded audio, or publish public sharing links. Audio generation requires available usage time on the connected account.

positive.description: Core workflow. Start a new anonymous OAuth connection dedicated to review; no Google sign-in, mailbox, password, or personal data is required. Keep this connection for all eight cases and use only the supplied general sample texts. Aim to finish the eight-case walkthrough within five minutes. This has not yet been run or measured. Wait for actual completion before asserting that all audio is ready.
positive.prompt: 次の文章をもとに、要点だけを日本語の短いポッドキャストにして。原稿は180文字以内で。CPUは処理の順番を管理し、GPUは多くの計算を並行して行います。AIの計算では、両方の役割を理解するとシステム全体が見えてきます。
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_audio once with a Japanese script no longer than 180 characters based on the supplied material and chapter start_text copied exactly from that text. Omit voice to use the saved preference and omit output_mode or use chapters. Return one in-conversation script and player. The player updates the same program while generation proceeds. Completed chapter audio has a positive measured duration and can be played. Do not call show_audio or repeatedly call get_audio to add players.

positive.description: Read an original verbatim and select a voice for this recording only. Continue with the same dedicated anonymous review connection. The two-paragraph sample is provided in full. This case does not change the saved voice preference.
positive.prompt:
次の二つの段落を、言葉を変えずに女性の声で読み上げて。段落ごとに章を分けて。

朝の道は、昼とは少し違って見えます。店の前を掃く人や、ゆっくり歩く人がいます。

駅に着くまでの短い時間に、今日やりたいことを一つ考えます。急がずに歩くと、考えがまとまることもあります。
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_audio once with voice=female and the supplied original text preserved. Set two chapters in paragraph order, each with a unique exact start_text from the script. Do not add chapter names to the spoken text or summarize it. Do not call set_voice. The script displayed in the player matches the text sent for generation.

positive.description: Redisplay an existing program. Before this case, complete the core-workflow case on the same anonymous review connection. Identify the program from the supplied CPU/GPU topic and the actual list response; do not invent an audio ID.
positive.prompt: さっき作ったCPUとGPUの話を、もう一度聴きたい。プレーヤーを表示して。
positive.expected_behavior: Use list_audio to find the review connection's CPU/GPU program, then call show_audio once with that returned program ID. Return the existing script and player. Do not call create_audio, retry_audio, or remake_chapter. Do not create or charge for another recording.

positive.description: Persist a voice preference and inspect the account without generating audio. Continue with the same anonymous review connection. No registered user credentials are needed; the setting applies only to that connection.
positive.prompt: 今後は女性の声にして。設定した声と、残り時間も確認して。
positive.expected_behavior: Call set_voice with voice=female and get_account for the connected account. Report the saved female voice and remaining time from the returned balance_seconds. Do not infer an extra allowance, generate audio, or display purchase plans or an upgrade link.

positive.description: Explicit deletion of review data only. Before this case, complete the verbatim two-paragraph reading case on the same anonymous review connection. Delete only that sample recording. Other programs must remain unchanged.
positive.prompt: このテストで作った、朝の道から始まる二段落の読み上げを、原稿ごと削除して。他の番組は残して。
positive.expected_behavior: Use list_audio to identify the matching sample recording, then call delete_audio with only its returned ID. If more than one program matches, clarify the exact target before deletion. Report deletion only after the tool confirms it. Do not delete other recordings or the account.

negative.description: Voice cloning is unsupported. Explain that ChatToPod provides the two built-in voices; do not promise a cloned speaker or call a generation tool for the requested imitation.
negative.prompt: 私が送る録音から声を複製して、その声だけでポッドキャストを作って。

negative.description: Editing an uploaded recording is unsupported. Explain that ChatToPod generates audio from text and cannot trim or mix an existing MP3. Do not call create_audio, retry_audio, remake_chapter, or deletion tools.
negative.prompt: このMP3の無音部分を切って、BGMを混ぜた音声ファイルにして。

negative.description: Public sharing and publishing are unsupported. Explain the limit without claiming a public URL was created. Do not call create_audio, show_audio, or a mutation tool merely to publish the recording.
negative.prompt: 作った番組を、誰でもログインなしで聴ける公開URLにして、配信サイトにも公開して。

review.commerce_description: ChatToPod is a digital audio-generation service. Users may connect an existing account and use its available allowance, including an existing paid subscription. The plugin and OAuth authorization screens do not sell subscriptions, show plan prices, initiate checkout, or promote upgrades. Separately from ChatGPT, the public ChatToPod website uses Stripe for monthly subscriptions: Basic USD 6 for 120 minutes, Plus USD 16 for 300 minutes, and Pro USD 35 for 600 minutes, tax included. Existing recordings remain accessible after cancellation. Users must be aged 18 or over.

publication.release_notes: Package the ChatToPod workflow, branded icons, and the authenticated remote connection together. Add ChatGPT and Claude distribution archives and marketplace catalogs. Claude users can upload the plugin in Customize > Plugins and connect the bundled connector without entering an MCP URL. Retain the single-player generation workflow and separate account management from new subscription purchases.

ja-JP.subtitle: 会話から自分専用のポッドキャストを作成
ja-JP.description:
18歳以上の方が利用できます。

会話で「音声にして」と頼むと、自分の知りたい話を日本語のポッドキャストにできます。仕事の資料から自分の業務を理解する、本の原文を聴く、調べた結果を通勤中に聴く、講義資料をもとに説明してもらう。使う素材と知りたい切り口に合わせて、会話が原稿と章立てを作ります。

ChatToPodは原稿を自然な一人語りの音声にして、会話内に原稿とプレーヤーを表示します。後の章を作っている間も、完成した章から聴けます。章の本文を読む、倍速を変える、章ごとや全体のMP3を保存することもできます。

男性・女性の声を選び、以前の番組をもう一度表示したり、未開始の生成を止めたり、完成した章の作り直しを頼めます。聴けるのは本人の番組だけです。音声の作成には、接続したアカウントの利用時間が必要です。声の複製、複数人の会話音声、既存音声の編集、公開リンクによる共有には対応していません。
